svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: what are Sand's coding habits like? Computed from the actual commit log: Favorite first word in a commit: "add" (8 times). Very decisive. Most commits land on Thursdays. Night-owl index: 20% of commits arrive after 9pm. Speaks Java, TypeScript, Python, GDScript (fluently-ish). Q: what shipped lately? Here's the latest public work: Oct 1 aeronautics_deliver… chore: update mod authors in gradle properties Oct 1 TheSandemon refactor(profile): remove Technomads mentions from profile visuals and agent chat Oct 1 TheSandemon docs(profile): update sand.gallery links to kyletouchet.dev Sep 25 TheSandemon Grow the agent chat from Sand's resume Sep 25 TheSandemon Replace the lab with an endlessly typing agent chat Sep 24 Th…
